facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: Ranganatha Ramayana was written by the poet Ranganatha—also known as Gona Budda Reddy—between 1300 and 1310 A.D.
facts.text: The Telugu Ranganatha Ramayana, composed between 1300 and 1310 CE, explicitly describes Lakshmana carving protective lines around the cottage with the tip of his bow.

facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: रामानुज लघु रेख खचाई। सोउ नहिं नाघेहु असि मनुसाई॥
facts.text: Tulsidas omits the drawing of the boundary line in the Aranya Kanda of the Ramcharitmanas, though Mandodari later references Ravana failing to cross Lakshmana's line in the Lanka Kanda.

facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: The original Krittivasi Ramayan is dated to the first half of the 15th century... where the protective line around Sita's cottage is detailed.
facts.text: The fifteenth-century Bengali Krittivasi Ramayan helped popularize the episode in regional folklore by describing the perimeter as an impassable barrier that compelled Ravana to rely on deception.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: In 1975-76, Prof Lal worked on the 'Archaeology of Ramayana Sites' by excavating five sites mentioned in the Ramayana - Ayodhya, Bharadwaj ashram, Nandigram, Chitrakoot and Shringaverapur.
facts.text: In 1975, the Archaeological Survey of India launched the national project titled Archaeology of Ramayana Sites under director general B.B. Lal to excavate major settlements mentioned in the epic.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: yielded archaeologic material belonging to seven different cultural periods in a total deposit of nearly 9 m below the top surface
facts.text: Archaeological Survey of India excavations at the Ramayana site of Sringaverapura documented cultural habitation across seven distinct periods spanning nearly nine metres of stratified deposits.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: Excavations at Nasik and Jorwe (1950-51) revealed early historical and chalcolithic sequences on the banks of Godavari.
facts.text: Excavations conducted at Nashik in 1950 by archaeologists H.D. Sankalia and S.B. Deo unearthed early historical and chalcolithic deposits along the banks of the Godavari River.

facts.label: disputed
facts.quote: Sankalia argued on internal botanical, geographical, and archaeological grounds that Ravana's Lanka and Dandakaranya were located in central India rather than peninsular South India and Sri Lanka.
facts.text: Scholars disagree over the geographical location of epic Panchavati and Dandakaranya, with traditional belief placing them at Nashik while archaeologist H.D. Sankalia argued that the original narrative was confined to central India.

facts.label: legend
facts.quote: Local tradition in Nashik identifies Sita Gufa near five banyan trees as the exact spot where Sita took shelter before Ravana abducted her.
facts.text: Local pilgrimage folklore in Nashik maintains that the underground chambers of Sita Gufa denote the exact forest hideout where Sita resided prior to her abduction.

scenes.vo: Lekin yahan imaandaari zaroori hai. Khudai yeh batati hai ki yahan bahut purane log rehte the. Yeh nahi batati ki kaunsi katha kab hui.

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: Photorealistic old reed pen resting on a palm leaf beside a small clay lamp, behind it through a window a river valley at dusk, calm wooden sill in the lower fifth, no readable text

scenes.vo: Aur rekha? Uska nishaan mitti mein nahi, kitaabon mein hai. Rekha kaviyon ki kalam se nikli thi. Toh khoj ab chalti hai Panchavati ki taraf.

scenes.label: disputed

scenes.vo: Parampara ka jawab saaf hai. Panchavati yaani aaj ka Nashik, Maharashtra mein Godavari ke kinare. Shraddhalu ise Sita haran ki dharti maante hain.

scenes.label: archaeology

scenes.vo: Saal 1950. Nashik mein Godavari kinare khudai shuru hoti hai. Team mein the Deccan College ke H.D. Sankalia aur S.B. Deo. Kya milta hai?

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: Photorealistic close view of small stone blades and a green-corroded copper tool lying on dark soil in a trench, a trowel beside them, natural light, calm soil in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Taamba patthar yug ki parten, yaani chalcolithic. Woh daur jab insaan patthar ke auzaaron ke saath taamba bhi istemaal karne laga. Uske upar shuruaati itihaas ke nishaan.

scenes.label: disputed

visual.prompt: Photorealistic aerial view of the Godavari bending past Nashik's old riverside town and temple spires, green hills of the Deccan beyond, calm river water in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Matlab Nashik mein Godavari kinare bahut purane zamane se log baste the. Lekin ab ulta mod aata hai. Wahi Sankalia, jo Nashik khod chuke the.

scenes.label: disputed

visual.prompt: Photorealistic scholar's study with old books stacked high, an elderly man in spectacles seen from behind writing at a desk by a window, afternoon light, calm floor in the lower fifth, no readable text

scenes.vo: Apni kitaab Ramayana in Historical Perspective mein Sankalia bilkul alag baat kehte hain. Unke hisaab se Dandakaranya aur Panchavati asal mein Madhya Bharat mein the.

scenes.label: disputed

visual.prompt: Photorealistic aerial view of the Vindhya hills in central India covered in dense dry forest, a river gorge cutting through, monsoon clouds, calm forest canopy in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Dandakaranya yaani Ramayan ka bada ghana jungle. Sankalia ne katha ke ped paudhe, nadiyan aur bhoogol padha. Aur kaha, asli katha Vindhya ke aas paas simti thi.

scenes.label: disputed

visual.prompt: Photorealistic hilltop view in central India at dusk, a lake surrounded by forested hills and rocky outcrops, birds flying home, calm lake water in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Unhone Ravan ki Lanka tak ko Madhya Bharat mein rakha. Aaj ke Sri Lanka mein nahi. Lekin parampara aur kai scholars yeh baat nahi maante.

scenes.label: disputed

visual.prompt: Photorealistic old paper map of India spread on a wooden table with river lines and hills, a brass compass and a magnifying glass resting on it, warm light, calm table edge in the lower fifth, no readable text

scenes.vo: Toh tasveer yeh bani. Parampara kehti hai Nashik, Godavari, Panchavati. Sankalia kehte hain Madhya Bharat, Vindhya. Aur faisla? Abhi tak kisi ke paas nahi.

scenes.label: disputed

visual.prompt: Photorealistic misty forest path at dawn fading into white fog, an old stone marker half hidden by ferns, calm path in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Ab baat un sawaalon ki, jinka jawab abhi kisi ke paas nahi. Sabse bada sawaal. Rekha ka khayal pehli baar kis kavi ne diya?

scenes.label: disputed

visual.prompt: Photorealistic travelling storyteller in a turban and dhoti walking with a bundle and a small drum along a village road at sunset, fields on both sides, calm dirt road in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Ho sakta hai kisi kathavachak ne ise pehle bola ho. Kathavachak yaani gaon gaon katha sunane wala. Likhne se bahut pehle. Par uska naam kahin darj nahi.

scenes.label: disputed

visual.prompt: Photorealistic overgrown ancient mound covered in grass and scattered bricks under a cloudy sky, a lone banyan tree on top, calm grass in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Agla sawaal, kya jungle ki yeh jagahein kisi asli basti se judti hain? Panchavati, Sita ki kutiya, Jatayu ka maidan. Khudai abhi tak yeh jod nahi paayi.

scenes.label: disputed

visual.prompt: Photorealistic temple courtyard at dusk with clay lamps lit in rows along the steps, devotees' silhouettes at a distance, calm stone floor in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Aur yeh bhi samjhiye. Valmiki mein rekha nahi, iska matlab yeh nahi ki baad ki katha kam keemti hai. Har kavi ne apne zamane ke logon ke liye katha kahi.

scenes.label: scripture

visual.prompt: Photorealistic row of different regional manuscripts laid side by side on a long table, palm leaf, handmade paper and cloth-bound volumes, soft daylight, calm table surface in the lower fifth, no readable text

scenes.vo: Ranganatha ne Telugu ghar ke liye likha. Krittivas ne Bengal ke liye, Tulsidas ne Awadh ke liye. Rekha har baar thodi badli, par bhaav wahi raha.

scenes.label: disputed

visual.prompt: Photorealistic ancient forest shrine under a giant tree, offerings of flowers on a stone, and in the earth before it a faint drawn line, evening light through leaves, calm ground in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Valmiki ke yahan suraksha prarthana thi, devtaon se. Baad ki kathaon mein wo prarthana mitti par kheenchi lakeer ban gayi. Shayad isliye, kyunki lakeer aankhon se dikhti hai.

scenes.label: legend

visual.prompt: Photorealistic morning aarti on the Godavari ghats in Nashik, brass lamps raised by priests, pilgrims on the steps, temple bells hanging, calm river water in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Toh aaj aap Nashik jaayein, toh kya dekhenge? Godavari ka ghaat, mandiron ki ghantiyan, aur Panchavati ke purane bargad ke ped. Subah ki aarti ke saath.

scenes.label: legend

visual.prompt: Photorealistic narrow stone stairway descending into a dim underground chamber lit by oil lamps, old banyan roots visible near the entrance, calm stone floor in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Bargad ke pedon ke paas hai Sita Gufa. Yaani zameen ke neeche bane chhote kamre. Andar jaane ke liye jhuk kar utarna padta hai.

scenes.label: legend

visual.prompt: Photorealistic pilgrims seen from behind queuing quietly under huge banyan trees near a small shrine entrance, marigold garlands, soft morning light, calm paved ground in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Sthaniya parampara kehti hai, yahi woh jagah hai jahan Sita haran se pehle rehti thin. Yeh lok vishwas hai, khudai ka saboot nahi. Par shraddha gehri hai.

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: Photorealistic riverbank at Nashik in late afternoon, temple steps on one side and an old eroded earthen bank with exposed soil layers on the other, calm river water in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Aur jab aap wahan khade honge, toh zara sochiyega. Yahi Godavari ka kinara, jiske paas 1950 mein archaeologist mitti khod rahe the. Aastha aur khudai, saath saath, isi nadi ke kinare.

scenes.label: disputed

visual.prompt: Photorealistic hidden forest clearing deep in central Indian hills with a small stream and ancient trees, shafts of sunlight, no people, calm stream water in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Aur agar Sankalia sahi the, toh asli Panchavati shayad Vindhya ke jungle mein hai. Jise abhi tak koi pehchaan nahi paaya. Socho, kitna bada rahasya.

scenes.label: scripture

visual.prompt: Photorealistic close view of a line scratched in earth at the edge of a hut threshold, with an old palm-leaf manuscript lying beside it, warm sunset light, calm earth in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Toh shuru ka sawaal yaad hai? Lakshman Rekha aayi kahan se? Valmiki se nahi. Madhyakaal ke kaviyon se, Telugu, Bangla aur Awadhi ke panno se.

scenes.label: scripture

visual.prompt: Photorealistic empty forest hermitage at blue hour, a single clay lamp burning in the doorway, the forest silent around it, calm earth in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Aur Valmiki ka asli scene isse bhi gehra hai. Darr, shak, kadve shabd, aur bhai ka toota dil. Koi jaadui deewar nahi, sirf insaani rishte.

scenes.label: disputed

visual.prompt: Photorealistic aerial view of a rocky island coastline at dawn with dense jungle and cliffs, waves breaking, calm sea surface in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Agli video mein hum chalenge Sankalia ke sabse bade sawaal par. Ravan ki Lanka, kya sach mein aaj ka Sri Lanka thi? Sabut ke saath.

scenes.label: legend

visual.prompt: Photorealistic Indian family courtyard at night, an elderly grandmother and children sitting together under a starry sky with an oil lamp, seen from behind, calm floor in the lower fifth

scenes.vo: Aur ab aapki baari, comment mein bataiye. Lakshman Rekha ki kahani aapne pehli baar kisse suni? Dadi se, ya TV se? Main har jawab padhunga.
